wholePhysicalScope: Native five-storey Building R geometry, the independently surveyed number 42 entrance and the named school fix its location and orientation.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the entrance canopy and oculus, two wings and the atrium. Near views add copper seams, closely spaced glazing mullions and office louvers.
limitations: The model covers the R42 building on the Solbosch campus and its immediate entrances. The other university buildings occupy separate locations.
The underlying mapped perimeter and both entrances are exact horizontal controls. Eave height, west canopy edge and opening, copper panel spacing, and individual façade dimensions are interpreted.

Terrain samples establish the rising grade between entrances as a geographic preview. The broad 12 m site relief also extends off the building footprint. Interior furnishings and signage are simplified.
